headline: 60% of click-color episodes present the target colour as a rendered SWATCH, not a word. Reading #query.innerText returns an empty string. The task is not broken; a text-only address channel is blind.

evidence.behaviour: if core.randi(0,100) < 40 the goal names the colour in a span; otherwise it embeds a div with background-color set to the target and NO text
evidence.measured: 8 of 10 sampled episodes returned an empty colour token via innerText
evidence.mistaken_conclusion_i_first_drew: 'the task has a defect, the colour name is missing' -- WRONG. The colour is present, as pixels.
evidence.how_it_was_caught: reading the task source instead of trusting the innerText parse

why_this_matters_more_than_the_score: it is the same failure class as 4 of the 5 remaining MiniWob failures: click-dialog (glyph 'x'), click-link (anchor text not exposed as accessible name), choose-list (options absent from DOM until opened), click-color (colour as swatch)
it means the 5/10 in R122 understates reach for a REASONS THE AGENT CAN FIX WITHOUT LEARNING ANYTHING NEW
and it is a failure I committed myself while arguing that perception was the ceiling -- the argument was right and I was an instance of it
the_first_principles_statement: learning is a multiplier (x1.0 once solved). Perception is the coefficient. Five independent failures today were all coefficient failures, zero were multiplier failures.

cli_mcp_logic_escape_hatch.observation: many MiniWob tasks expose the expected answer in page variables the agent could read if it were allowed to run arbitrary JS
cli_mcp_logic_escape_hatch.why_it_is_NOT_used_for_scoring: reading the answer out of the page is oracle access, not computer use. It would inflate the number and teach nothing.
cli_mcp_logic_escape_hatch.why_it_IS_the_right_strategy_for_real_co: a human operator on a real machine uses devtools, the filesystem and the clipboard constantly. The honest distinction is: use code-execution to READ THE WORLD and to ACCELERATE, never to READ THE GRADER.
cli_mcp_logic_escape_hatch.literature: Qwen-UI-Agent (2026) reports a unified GUI+CLI action space where CLI and GUI clicks are the two dominant action types and over 40% of actions are batched, which the authors report substantially shortens trajectories

the_next_build_and_why_it_is_the_smartes.build: extend the address channel from DOM text to RENDERED appearance: computed background-color, glyph/symbol text, alt/aria/title attributes, and open-then-enumerate for closed selects
the_next_build_and_why_it_is_the_smartes.expected_effect: converts click-color, click-dialog, click-link and choose-list from impossible to measurable without any new learning machinery
the_next_build_and_why_it_is_the_smartes.why_not_a_new_learner: the multiplier is already 1.0. Raising it further cannot raise a product whose coefficient is the constraint.
